steps.content: The ambush ends swiftly and decisively. The assassin is quickly transferred to a safe house for interrogation, and the 9th Agency also sends a hypnosis expert to assist in the investigation.
Christina was forbidden from attending the interrogation. She had completed her own work and was sitting in the break room, feeling a bit dazed.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The body that the Mentor "bloomed" would stop all normal physiological responses. But I think, the real time of Eugean's death was August 9th.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The night that the rookie from the Garden saved me.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: She must have deeply hated Eugean, so she disregarded the Garden's rules and personally sought revenge... even if it meant angering her Mentor.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: I should have killed you back then!
Christina leans back, sinking into the couch, and looks up at the ceiling, exhausted.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...On her way back from revenge, did she feel lost for the first time? That's why she saved me, even though I'm clearly her enemy...

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Don't overthink. At least you caught her.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: If she returned to the Garden after getting her revenge, she would truly become an assassin, only taking more lives, turning from confusion to numbness. It's good as it is now, at least she is fiercely hating you.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: You can't make everyone happy or win everyone's approval, but you're doing what you think is right.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Your first big case, you did a great job, even exceeding expectations. You can take a good rest now.
Christina nods, utterly exhausted after all that's happened. She hopes everything is over now. She opens up the news on her phone and puts on her headphones.

On the screen, a stern and resolute old man is being bombarded by countless cameras and microphones. Christina recognizes him, he's the current Commander-in-Chief of FAC, who took office after the Eclipse Operation.

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Can you tell us what the FAC's compensation case has to do with this case? Were there any Sinners involved in the case? Is it related to the FAC Commander-in-Chief's return?

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Why is the FAC involved in this security case? Is this within their jurisdiction?! Is there something else going on about this operation plan?

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Give us an explanation! More people are paying attention, you can't hide this!

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: ...We have nothing to hide. All of FAC's plans and intentions are to protect the city-state, and our operations won't be hindered by such minor issues. I've returned solely to advance the operation proposal.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: But since you're here for an interview, I'll take this opportunity to say a few words to the criminals.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Stop targeting ordinary people. If your target is FAC, come at us directly. I'll see you on the battlefield.
Leaving the Eastside Public Security Bureau building, Christina walks alone in the quiet alleyway.
The poem and her serial cases have been completed, so what will that woman do next?
If Thistle could sneak out of the Garden, it is most likely that the Mentor isn't at the base right now. So where would she go? To find her client? Or to bloom another flower?
Anyway, the Mentor has never taken her seriously from the beginning. Christina has completely understood this, and suddenly, she has a strong desire to see her.

She wants to ask Coquelic, what is all of this for? Is it necessary to hinder such an important operation? Is it necessary to side with the Underground? By sacrificing the chance to save the West District, does the vengeance obtained make the Garden happy?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Inspector, I'm inexperienced, careless, and I often mess things up...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But sometimes, my terrible intuition... is surprisingly accurate.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: My intuition tells me that the assassination from the poem is not over yet.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Given that woman's flamboyant personality, it's impossible for her to end it... quietly.
As she is saying this, suddenly, something sharp pricks the back of her head. Before she could react in shock, Christina lost consciousness.
The results of the interrogation are handed over to the Hush.

Under hypnosis, the Garden Assassin spills everything she knows, limited information. The most important intel has been subjected to counter psychological suggestion and can't be currently extracted.

She worries that the Mentor has taken on a commission from evil forces, she has caught a glimpse of a long list. She knows the Mentor made a dangerous trade for some reason.

She deeply regrets sabotaging the Mentor's plan.
Shalom quietly flips through the report.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: In autumn's prime, wine and meat gleam. Gold and silver set the festive scene... As year's end nears, vast and wide, over dried-up wells, I alone stride.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...As year's end nears, vast and wide, over dried-up wells, I alone stride.
The writing is awkward but full of pride. The author must be very proud of this, she must want to execute her plan perfectly.
But the plan was ultimately disrupted. She had to split into two scenes to cover for another little assassin.
The two scenes essentially form a sentence of the poem, "set the festive scene." The real target of "As year's end nears... I alone stride" is...

She glances at the timetable, the agenda for the West District operation proposal is coming up soon. If the Underground wants to disrupt it, if she <color=#fb9259>herself</color> wants to disrupt it, then compared to this tickling performance, she would...
Shalom smiles.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Since it's a grand blooming, I suppose it won't just end here. Right, Mentor...?

steps.speaker: Internal Alert
steps.content: <size=48><color=#dg1f1f>All personnel assemble!! The Commander-in-Chief has been attacked! The Commander-in-Chief has been attacked!</size></color>

steps.speaker: Internal Alert
steps.content: The criminal is a <color=#fb9259>Garden Assassin</color>!!
